title: The container's run-epic dispatches with the cloud profiles, so no worker shares the orchestrator's container
description:
Triaged 2026-09-23 from xte's close-out, which held on untriaged findings; the finding keys it absorbs are in this tick's notes. xte was merged as building blocks (operator's choice B) and its unmet goal moved here, because it is the same single cloud path yoh reconciles.

The container runs ticfac run-epic with the COMPILED-IN profiles/ (executor local-subprocess), so every cloud worker runs as a subprocess inside the orchestrator's own container (5d5e3f93, high) - which is how the 2026-09-23 smoke tick ran. The staged entrypoint must run run-epic with the cloud profile set (profiles-cloudflare-sandbox) and the cloud substrate, proven through the staged script rather than by reading it (7be27471).
